summary: Build practical delegation matrices, control logs, and governance dashboards in this 5-day course. Strengthen accountability and audit readiness.
lede: Delegation of authority and governance controls clarify decision rights, approval limits and checks so decisions have clear ownership. This course is for governance, audit, compliance, finance, operations and procurement professionals who work with approvals and control structures. It covers mapping authority gaps, designing delegation matrices and maker-checker controls, assessing segregation of duties, tracking exceptions and evidence, and preparing governance reports.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who work with approval rights, control structures, escalation pathways, or governance reporting and need a practical way to tighten authority design. Governance Officers managing authority policies and escalation rules. Internal Auditors testing approval controls and evidence trails. Compliance Managers overseeing control adherence and exception handling. Finance Controllers reviewing payment and signing authority. Operations Managers coordinating delegated approvals across workflows. Procurement Managers controlling purchase sign-offs and supplier approvals. Risk Managers mapping authority gaps to operational exposure. Company Secretaries supporting board-level delegation structures. HR Business Partners aligning authority with role design. Business Process Analysts documenting approval workflows and control points.
prerequisites: Bring familiarity with your organization’s approval hierarchy, delegation policy, or control workflow. A laptop is recommended for working through templates, drafting matrices, and completing digital exercises.
